qualifying_activity: Record students' own design goals/spatial priorities outside AI exchanges before generation, or revise independently before regenerating; prompts alone do not qualify.

component_name: Document and reflect on design decisions
qualifying_activity: Use alternative, problem, revision or decision records for process reflection/review; research-only records do not qualify.
Direct generation through students' own representations, constraints, local edits, training material or workflow controls.

component_name: Adjust AI use and output detail
qualifying_activity: Deliberately adjust output detail and extent of AI use through abstract representations, bounded use, independent work or reasoned convergence. No named stage is required; early design alone does not qualify.
Apply criteria to compare, reject, reinterpret or challenge AI outputs/suggestions.
Check proposals through drawings, models, materials, site/user knowledge or independent sources; presentation-only models do not qualify.

component_name: Critique and assess the design process
qualifying_activity: Instructor/peer critique examines student reasoning, decisions or design processes.
Explicitly examine model limits, bias or uncertainty and implications for design judgment, beyond software instruction.
